title: About Us
description: Unleash the Power of Digital Marketing!

value.title: Meet the Founders
value.description:
Why We're Here: Providing local indoor digital billboards and marketing solutions for trusted hometown businesses to connect with their community, and sharing uplifting content relevant to Sioux Falls and the surrounding towns.

Amos is a community connector and proud husband and father, passionate about living life intentionally. His values center around personal growth, faith, and creating connections through genuine relationships.

His wife, Kelsey, is the owner and founder of Wonderfully Made Gifting Company and balances her creative work with helping Uplift Local Media's back-end operations and raising two daughters, Charlotte and Mirabelle. She's dedicated to creating meaningful gifts and experiences that bring joy and simplicity into people's lives.

Together, they're building a network that helps local businesses thrive by showcasing their stories and bringing uplifting messages into everyday spaces.

value.title: Meet The Uplift Local Media Team

members.name: Sean Givens
members.bio: As the Director of Digital Marketing, Sean Givens leverages his extensive experience to spearhead integrated digital campaigns that drive revenue and brand engagement. He oversees a large cross-functional team, providing strategic direction while masterfully managing hundreds of client accounts and projects. Sean’s ability to develop innovative digital roadmaps, coupled with his exceptional project management skills, ensures campaigns are executed seamlessly across channels. His leadership fosters an environment of collaboration and accountability, empowering his team to deliver superior results that exceed client expectations.

members.name: Claire Cone
members.bio: Claire is the Digital Marketing Department Manager, as well as a seasoned consultant specializing in digital marketing. She leads consultative calls, develops tailored marketing strategies, and provides exceptional client communication to ensure the best digital marketing solutions are implemented for each client’s unique needs.

members.name: Hattie Thomas
members.bio: Hattie is a Digital Marketing Strategist who helps clients choose the best digital marketing products for their business. She customizes solutions to maximize exposure and engagement while overseeing consultations and maintaining clear communication. Hattie also conducts product training, providing insightful analysis and strategic guidance tailored to each business’s needs. Passionate about supporting business growth, she leverages digital tools to simplify processes and enhance performance, helping clients navigate the digital landscape effectively.

members.name: Danielle Silvestri
members.bio: Dani brings extensive expertise in managing high-performance geo-targeted, display, and PPC campaigns that drive impressive results. As an expert in his field, he excels at customizing campaigns with precision targeting and fine-tuned optimizations to ensure the best possible outcomes for each client’s unique goals. Dani’s keen ability to analyze data and adapt strategies on the fly allows him to consistently maximize ROI across diverse industries and markets. His campaigns are renowned for their innovative approaches and meticulous execution.

members.name: Ethan Hennessey
members.bio: As a Digital Marketing Strategist, I collaborate with clients to develop and implement tailored digital marketing solutions that maximize their online visibility and engagement. My responsibilities include strategic consultations, efficiently managing project pipelines, and maintaining clear, consistent communication to ensure client objectives are met. I focus on providing insightful analysis and strategic guidance, crafting approaches that are precisely aligned with each business’s unique needs. Passionate about empowering businesses to thrive, I leverage various digital tools and innovative strategies to streamline processes, optimize performance, and help clients confidently navigate the dynamic digital landscape.
